description: ONE-SHOT: resolve a verified-fit kit and return a hosted PayPal approve URL. Prefer for clear buy intent (“order me an S7 kit”). Single verified match → checkout immediately. Multiple matches → returns choices (ask human). Pass deviceQuery (+ optional need) OR productId/slug. Display: MCP App → map structuredContent.card to host card → else messageToHuman markdown exactly. Wait ~60s then poll getOrderStatus every 60s.

deviceQuery.description: Device model text, e.g. Roborock S7 or S7+

need.description: What they want, e.g. 3-month kit, bulk pack, filter

productId.description: Product id or slug if already known

name: quickCheckout
